# Cameroon OpenSourceRail Campaign
<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-marketing-campaigns.py. -->

National outreach package covering **10 catalogued cities**. Values
below aggregate city screening models; the national brief separately treats the
shared manufacturing plant.

## Audience

- Cameroon ministry responsible for transport and urban mobility
- Cameroon national climate, energy or Green Climate Fund authority
- Cameroon public investment, planning or finance authority
- Embassy or High Commission of Cameroon in the United Kingdom — economic section

## National proposition

| Measure | Catalogue result |
|---|---:|
| Population represented | 11,650,000 |
| Lines / route length | 32 / 750 km |
| Fleet | 1,326 trainsets |
| City programme CAPEX | $7.20 B |
| Local capital and value allocation | $5.36 B (74%) |
| Station/depot PV / storage | 123.5 MW / 717.5 MWh |
| Illustrative external-capital saving | $11.12 B |

Lead with a government-reviewed pilot, local manufacturing and construction,
open standards, renewable-energy integration and independently checked demand,
environmental, social and engineering studies.
